title: Cambridge IGCSE First Language English 0500/0990 — Paper 1 Reading

authority.why_this_source: NO official Cambridge mark scheme for this syllabus era is on disk for Paper 1. The only P1 mark scheme we hold is 718838-2027-specimen, which belongs to the 2027-2029 syllabus — a DIFFERENT paper, and wrong for a candidate sitting Oct/Nov 2026. The syllabus states every tariff explicitly and is the board's own document, so it is the authority here. ⚠️ REPLACE THIS with the June 2024 (or any 2024-2026 series) Paper 1 mark scheme the moment one is on disk.
authority.checked_2026_08_18: 160 PDFs in 'Cambridge IGCSE English 0500-0990/Past Papers (mirror 2020-2026)' — 80 question papers + 80 inserts, ZERO mark schemes.

protocols_note: Cambridge has NO protocol-a-assessment.md — it is served through topic templates (protocols/shared/templates/topics/cambridge-igcse-language-p1.md), which carry no 'Assessment Sub-Protocol: Question N' sections, so check E cannot read them. The chain is covered in two hops instead: this file proves BOARD PDF -> language-paper-specs.json (check D), and bin/cambridge-topics-gate.php runs the real SWML_Topic_Parser and proves TEMPLATE -> that same 80-mark spec. Do not add a protocols[] entry here expecting it to check the template; extend the Cambridge gate instead.
